decisions.reason: As a newly launched CD line close to the firm’s core catalog, with a dedicated product page and no clear negative market evidence in a growing retail environment, management would likely continue it and justify the initial commitment as still needing time to pay off.

Because this illustrated release series builds directly on the firm’s established reissue and curation strengths, was visibly presented on its own page, and fits the stated expansion of formats and categories, management would likely persist rather than withdraw after such an early stage.
